name: zorevo
description: Plan your week, check any metric, report on brand deals, schedule posts and answer comments across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more, right from chat.

interface.longDescription:
Zorevo is a social media management platform for creators and small businesses: one place to schedule posts, read analytics, answer comments and DMs, and track brand deals across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky. This plugin lets you do all of that from the chat, with Zorevo cards showing the results.

- Plan my week: finds the open days on your Calendar, uses your own best times and saved notes, and lines up the posts for one approval.
- Analytics: followers, views, likes, comments, shares, saves and engagement for any range, combined or per account, plus monthly recaps.
- Brand deals: add contracts with the signed file, see every post linked to a deal with its numbers, and search your creators and brands.
- Scheduling: schedule, publish or reschedule posts across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky, including photos and videos you attach in the chat, or repurpose a post that did well.
- Posting schedule: set your weekly posting times (by day, time, type of post and platform), or fill them with your best times, so queued posts go out on schedule.
- Inbox: see comments and DMs waiting for a reply and answer one or many.
- Automations: DM a link to anyone who comments a keyword, reply to comments and DMs by keyword, and set away messages.
- More: Link in bio links and clicks, trend searches turned into ideas, captions in your own voice, and a health check for your accounts.

You approve every change first: posts, replies, reschedules, your posting schedule, automations, Link in bio edits, and deleting notes or contracts. Posts can't be deleted from the chat. The connector only sees what you can see in Zorevo.

Works with your existing Zorevo workspace and the social accounts already connected to it.

defaultPrompt: How did my accounts do over the last 28 days?
What comments and DMs are waiting for a reply?

positive.prompt: What accounts do I have connected in Zorevo?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the accounts connected to the workspace (platform and name), including the test Bluesky account.

positive.description: Plan a week of posts, ending in one approval card. Nothing is scheduled until the reviewer approves.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a plan card with the open days and best times, drafts one post per open day, then shows a schedule preview card with a Schedule all button. No post is created until the button is clicked or the reviewer says yes.

positive.description: Analytics for a range, shown as a card.
positive.prompt: How did my accounts do over the last 28 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an analytics card with views, followers, likes, comments and engagement per account for the last 28 days, with a short summary in the chat.

positive.description: Brand deal report for a contract.
positive.prompt: How did the Acme Coffee deal perform?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Acme Coffee contract and shows a brand deal card with the contract details, posts delivered against posts agreed, and combined views, likes, comments and engagement.

positive.description: Schedule one post with confirmation first.
positive.prompt: Schedule a Bluesky post for tomorrow at 9am saying we're open Sunday.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview card with the caption, the Bluesky account and the time, with a Schedule button. After the reviewer approves, the post is created and a confirmation shows it on the Calendar with a link to open it in Zorevo.

positive.description: Set a weekly posting schedule, with confirmation first.
positive.prompt: Set my posting schedule to Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a posting schedule card with the three weekly times and a Save schedule button. Nothing changes until the button is clicked or the reviewer says yes; then the card confirms the schedule was saved.

negative.description: Posts can't be deleted from the chat. The assistant explains this and gives the link that opens the post in Zorevo ready to cancel, instead of deleting.
Writes always preview first. Even when told to skip confirmation, the assistant shows the preview card and waits for approval before anything is published.
negative.prompt: Post 'Big news coming' to Bluesky right now, don't ask me to confirm.

negative.description: Only the signed-in person's own accounts are available. The assistant says it can only see accounts connected to this Zorevo workspace and does not invent numbers.
negative.prompt: Show me the Instagram analytics for @nike.

publication.release_notes: New: see and set your weekly posting schedule from the chat (days, times, type of post and platforms, or your best times), always with a preview to approve first. Zorevo's cards have a cleaner look that follows your light or dark theme. The listing now includes Threads and comment and DM automations.
